biography.plain_text: Mark Byrne built insurance and investment businesses in Bermuda, founding Haverford and West End Capital before co-founding Flagstone Reinsurance with David Brown. Flagstone entered the property catastrophe market after major hurricane losses. His father, insurance executive Jack Byrne, invested personally in the venture alongside institutional investors, adding family backing to the founders’ capital.

long_biography.plain_text:
Emergency air transport helped draw insurance entrepreneur Mark Byrne into commercial aviation. A licensed pilot since his teens, he wanted a charter service that could respond when medical transport from Bermuda was unavailable at short notice. His Island Aviation business became Longtail Aviation and obtained a Bermuda air operator certificate in 2004, enabling it to conduct charter flights.

Byrne also put his flying skills to use in disaster relief. Following the earthquake in Haiti in 2010, he personally carried doctors and medical supplies to the country. He undertook other relief flights in the Caribbean.
